# Candidate — Master CV

## Contact
- **Name:** Evgeny Shokk
- **Title:** Maintenance & Asset Integrity Expert
- **Location:** Dubai, UAE
- **Phone:** +971 50 404 6247
- **Email:** evgeny.shokk@email.com
- **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/evgeny-shokk-54781716/

## Professional summary
Senior Leader with 25+ years of experience in Asset Integrity, Maintenance Strategy Development, and Operational Assurance within upstream Oil & Gas facilities/systems maintenance. Extensive expertise in establishing Asset Maintenance Management Systems aligned with ISO 55001, implementing Safety Critical Element (SCE) Performance Standards, and leading technical assurance programs for critical control and safety systems.

**Key Achievements:**
- Developed and implemented maintenance and integrity frameworks for large onshore oil & gas assets, including equipment criticality, SCE governance, and CMMS integration.
- Led ESD/HIPPS Reliability Assurance using Lean Six Sigma, achieving 3× MTBF increase and reducing SEP-line downtime from 28 to 3 days/yr.
- Directed Instrument Scope of Work within a USD 115M GMC maintenance and integrity contract portfolio.
- Managed multi-year O&M budgets and delivered USD 30M in cost-optimization programs without compromising asset integrity or reliability performance.

## Core competencies
- Asset Integrity & Technical Assurance
- Maintenance Strategy Development & Optimization (RCM, FMECA, PdM, CBM)
- ISO 55001 Asset Management Systems
- ICSS (DCS, ESD, F&G, HIPPS) — Technical Integrity Assurance
- Functional Safety & SIS Lifecycle Management (IEC 61511)
- Alarm Management Lifecycle (ISA 18.2 / EEMUA 191)
- Safety Critical Elements (SCE) & Performance Standards
- CMMS / SAP PM Implementation, Data Governance & Architecture
- Operational Readiness & Project-to-Operations Handover
- EPC / Client Interface & Multidisciplinary Team Leadership
- Reliability Engineering & RCA (ISO 14224, Six Sigma, Lean)
- Strategic Budget Management & Contractor Governance

## Experience

### Lead Maintenance Expert | Maintenance Startup Manager
**LUKOIL Overseas Iraq Exploration B.V.** | Apr 2024 – Jan 2026 | Iraq / GCC
- Led development of the Asset Integrity and Maintenance framework for a greenfield EPC project.
- Established the Asset Maintenance Management System, including CMMS data framework and maintenance procedures aligned with ISO 55001.
- Directed Instrument Scope of Work within a USD 115M GMC maintenance and integrity contract portfolio.

### Maintenance Expert | Lead Maintenance Planning Engineer
**LUKOIL Middle East** | Dec 2020 – Apr 2024 | GCC / Middle East
- Managed maintenance planning and performance for onshore production assets.
- Led cross-functional maintenance teams, improving schedule adherence by 34% and reducing maintenance backlog by 27%.
- Managed multi-year O&M budgets and delivered USD 30M in cost-optimization programs without compromising asset integrity or reliability performance.

### Lead Instrument Engineer (Asset Integrity)
**LUKOIL Middle East** | Sep 2014 – Dec 2020 | GCC / Middle East
- Established SCE governance and Performance Standards, reducing SCE non-compliance by 25%.
- Led reliability projects using DMAIC-based Lean Six Sigma, achieving 3× MTBF improvement and reducing lifecycle maintenance cost by USD 2.7M.
- Led ESD/HIPPS Reliability Assurance using Lean Six Sigma, achieving 3× MTBF increase and reducing SEP-line downtime from 28 to 3 days/yr.

### Senior Instrument & Control System Engineer (Operation Readiness)
**LUKOIL Overseas Baltic Ltd** | Mar 2011 – Sep 2014 | Russia / International
- Established the Maintenance Management System and SAP PM CMMS database achieving 94% master-data completeness and PM-strategy coverage aligned with ISO 55001.
- Delivered SAP PM implementation and data governance for greenfield operation readiness.

### Technical Integrity & Reliability Engineer
**Salym Petroleum Development** | May 2008 – Mar 2011 | Russia / Siberia
- Led Maintenance Execution and Integrity Assurance, including SCE classification, SAP QM execution, and contract-scope optimization.

### Instrument & Control System Engineer (Operation Readiness)
**Salym Petroleum Development** | Sep 2005 – May 2008 | Russia / Siberia
- Delivered operations readiness supporting P&ID reviews, HAZID/HAZOP, SIL classification, SRS evaluation, and C&ED validation.

## Education & certifications
- **MEng, Instrument & Mechanical Design Engineering**, Volgograd State Technical University, Russia (1994–1999)
- **BEng, Engineering & Technology**, Volgograd State Technical University, Russia (1994–1997)

## Technical skills
- **Asset Management:** ISO 55001, GFMAM Asset Management Landscape, Asset Lifecycle Management
- **Maintenance Methodologies:** RCM, FMECA, PdM (Predictive), CBM (Condition-Based), PM Optimization
- **Functional Safety:** IEC 61511, SIL Classification, SRS, SIS Lifecycle, HIPPS, ESD/F&G
- **Instrumentation & Control:** DCS, ESD, F&G, HIPPS, ICSS, Alarm Management (ISA 18.2 / EEMUA 191)
- **CMMS / ERP:** SAP PM, SAP QM, CMMS data governance & architecture
- **Reliability Engineering:** ISO 14224, RCA, Lean Six Sigma, DMAIC, MTBF analysis
- **Standards:** ISO 55001, IEC 61511, ISA 18.2, EEMUA 191, HAZOP/HAZID, API standards
- **Project Management:** EPC interface, multi-discipline team leadership, contractor governance
- **QMS / Audit:** ISO 9001, QMS SME, Technical Audit

## Languages
- Russian — Native
- English — Professional (C1)
